With explicit insertions, it looks like this: ``` malicious! ▼▼▼▼▼▼▼▼▼ transferBalance(5678,6776,4321,"USD"); ▲▲▲▲▲▲▲▲ ▲▲▲▲▲▲▲▲ 🕵sneaky! 🕵sneaky! ``` In other words, this gives the code the _visual appearance_ of sending 6776 USD to recipient 1234, but that'"'"'s not what the _actual underlying text_ says; it says to transfer 4,321 USD to recipient 6776.
